passages.label: Mart. 4.1.1
passages.text: Caesaris alma dies et luce sacratior illa,

passages.label: Mart. 4.1.2
passages.text: Conscia Dictaeum qua tulit Ida Iovem,

passages.label: Mart. 4.1.3
passages.text: Longa, precor, Pylioque veni numerosior aevo

passages.label: Mart. 4.1.4
passages.text: Semper et hoc voltu vel meliore nite.

passages.label: Mart. 4.1.5
passages.text: Hic colat Albano Tritonida multus in auro

passages.label: Mart. 4.1.6
passages.text: Perque manus tantas plurima quercus eat;

passages.label: Mart. 4.1.7
passages.text: Hic colat ingenti redeuntia saecula lustro

passages.label: Mart. 4.1.8
passages.text: Et quae Romuleus sacra Tarentos habet.

passages.label: Mart. 4.1.9
passages.text: Magna quidem, superi, petimus, sed debita terris:

passages.label: Mart. 4.1.10
passages.text: Pro tanto quae sunt inproba vota deo?

passages.label: Mart. 4.2.1
passages.text: Spectabat modo solus inter omnes

passages.label: Mart. 4.2.2
passages.text: Nigris munus Horatius lacernis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.2.3
passages.text: Cum plebs et minor ordo maximusque

passages.label: Mart. 4.2.4
passages.text: Sancto cum duce candidus sederet.

passages.label: Mart. 4.2.5
passages.text: Toto nix cecidit repente caelo:

passages.label: Mart. 4.2.6
passages.text: Albis spectat Horatius lacernis.

passages.label: Mart. 4.3.1
passages.text: Aspice quam densum tacitarum vellus aquarum

passages.label: Mart. 4.3.2
passages.text: Defluat in voltus Caesaris inque sinus.

passages.label: Mart. 4.3.3
passages.text: Indulget tamen ille Iovi, nec vertice moto

passages.label: Mart. 4.3.4
passages.text: Concretas pigro frigore ridet aquas,

passages.label: Mart. 4.3.5
passages.text: Sidus Hyperborei solitus lassare Bootae

passages.label: Mart. 4.3.6
passages.text: Et madidis Helicen dissimulare comis.

passages.label: Mart. 4.3.7
passages.text: Quis siccis lascivit aquis et ab aethere ludit?

passages.label: Mart. 4.3.8
passages.text: Suspicor has pueri Caesaris esse nives.

passages.label: Mart. 4.4.1
passages.text: Quod siccae redolet palus lacunae,

passages.label: Mart. 4.4.2
passages.text: Crudarum nebulae quod Albularum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.4.3
passages.text: Piscinae vetus aura quod marinae,

passages.label: Mart. 4.4.4
passages.text: Quod pressa piger hircus in capella,

passages.label: Mart. 4.4.5
passages.text: Lassi vardaicus quod evocati,

passages.label: Mart. 4.4.6
passages.text: Quod bis murice vellus inquinatum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.4.7
passages.text: Quod ieiunia sabbatariarum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.4.8
passages.text: Maestorum quod anhelitus reorum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.4.9
passages.text: Quod spurcae moriens lucerna Ledae,

passages.label: Mart. 4.4.10
passages.text: Quod ceromata faece de Sabina,

passages.label: Mart. 4.4.11
passages.text: Quod volpis fuga, viperae cubile,

passages.label: Mart. 4.4.12
passages.text: Mallem quam quod oles olere, Bassa.

passages.label: Mart. 4.5.1
passages.text: Vir bonus et pauper linguaque et pectore verus,

passages.label: Mart. 4.5.2
passages.text: Quid tibi vis, urbem qui, Fabiane, petis?

passages.label: Mart. 4.5.3
passages.text: Qui nec leno potes nec comissator haberi,

passages.label: Mart. 4.5.4
passages.text: Nec pavidos tristi voce citare reos,

passages.label: Mart. 4.5.5
passages.text: Nec potes uxorem cari corrumpere amici,

passages.label: Mart. 4.5.6
passages.text: Nec potes algentes arrigere ad vetulas,

passages.label: Mart. 4.5.7
passages.text: Vendere nec vanos circa Palatia fumos,

passages.label: Mart. 4.5.8
passages.text: Plaudere nec Cano, plaudere nec Glaphyro:

passages.label: Mart. 4.5.9
passages.text: Unde miser vives? 'Homo certus, fidus amicus—'.

passages.label: Mart. 4.5.10
passages.text: Hoc nihil est: numquam sic Philomelus eris.

passages.label: Mart. 4.6.1
passages.text: Credi virgine castior pudica

passages.label: Mart. 4.6.2
passages.text: Et frontis tenerae cupis videri,

passages.label: Mart. 4.6.3
passages.text: Cum sis inprobior, Malisiane,

passages.label: Mart. 4.6.4
passages.text: Quam qui compositos metro Tibulli

passages.label: Mart. 4.6.5
passages.text: In Stellae recitat domo libellos.

passages.label: Mart. 4.7.1
passages.text: Cur, here quod dederas, hodie, puer Hylle, negasti,

passages.label: Mart. 4.7.2
passages.text: Durus tam subito, qui modo mitis eras?

passages.label: Mart. 4.7.3
passages.text: Sed iam causaris barbamque annosque pilosque.

passages.label: Mart. 4.7.4
passages.text: O nox quam longa es, quae facis una senem!

passages.label: Mart. 4.7.5
passages.text: Quid nos derides? here qui puer, Hylle, fuisti,

passages.label: Mart. 4.7.6
passages.text: Dic nobis, hodie qua ratione vir es?

passages.label: Mart. 4.8.1
passages.text: Prima salutantes atque altera conterit hora,

passages.label: Mart. 4.8.2
passages.text: Exercet raucos tertia causidicos,

passages.label: Mart. 4.8.3
passages.text: In quintam varios extendit Roma labores,

passages.label: Mart. 4.8.4
passages.text: Sexta quies lassis, septima finis erit,

passages.label: Mart. 4.8.5
passages.text: Sufficit in nonam nitidis octava palaestris,

passages.label: Mart. 4.8.6
passages.text: Imperat extructos frangere nona toros:

passages.label: Mart. 4.8.7
passages.text: Hora libellorum decuma est, Eupheme, meorum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.8.8
passages.text: Temperat ambrosias cum tua cura dapes

passages.label: Mart. 4.8.9
passages.text: Et bonus aetherio laxatur nectare Caesar

passages.label: Mart. 4.8.10
passages.text: Ingentique tenet pocula parca manu.

passages.label: Mart. 4.8.11
passages.text: Tunc admitte iocos: gressu timet ire licenti

passages.label: Mart. 4.8.12
passages.text: Ad matutinum nostra Thalia Iovem.

passages.label: Mart. 4.9.1
passages.text: Sotae filia clinici, Labulla,

passages.label: Mart. 4.9.2
passages.text: Deserto sequeris Clytum marito

passages.label: Mart. 4.9.3
passages.text: Et donas et amas: ἔχεισ ἀσώτωσ.

passages.label: Mart. 4.10.1
passages.text: Dum novus est nec adhuc rasa mihi fronte libellus,

passages.label: Mart. 4.10.2
passages.text: Pagina dum tangi non bene sicca timet,

passages.label: Mart. 4.10.3
passages.text: I puer et caro perfer leve munus amico,

passages.label: Mart. 4.10.4
passages.text: Qui meruit nugas primus habere meas.

passages.label: Mart. 4.10.5
passages.text: Curre, sed instructus: comitetur Punica librum

passages.label: Mart. 4.10.6
passages.text: Spongia: muneribus convenit illa meis.

passages.label: Mart. 4.10.7
passages.text: Non possunt nostros multae, Faustine, liturae

passages.label: Mart. 4.10.8
passages.text: Emendare iocos: una litura potest.

passages.label: Mart. 4.11.1
passages.text: Dum nimium vano tumefactus nomine gaudes

passages.label: Mart. 4.11.2
passages.text: Et Saturninum te, miser, esse pudet,

passages.label: Mart. 4.11.3
passages.text: Impia Parrhasia movisti bella sub ursa,

passages.label: Mart. 4.11.4
passages.text: Qualia qui Phariae coniugis arma tulit.

passages.label: Mart. 4.11.5
passages.text: Excideratne adeo fatum tibi nominis huius,

passages.label: Mart. 4.11.6
passages.text: Obruit Actiaci quod gravis ira freti?

passages.label: Mart. 4.11.7
passages.text: An tibi promisit Rhenus quod non dedit illi

passages.label: Mart. 4.11.8
passages.text: Nilus, et Arctois plus licuisset aquis?

passages.label: Mart. 4.11.9
passages.text: Ille etiam nostris Antonius occidit armis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.11.10
passages.text: Qui tibi conlatus, perfide, Caesar erat.

passages.label: Mart. 4.12.1
passages.text: Nulli, Thai, negas, sed si te non pudet istud,

passages.label: Mart. 4.12.2
passages.text: Hoc saltem pudeat, Thai, negare nihil.

passages.label: Mart. 4.13.1
passages.text: Claudia, Rufe, meo nubit Peregrina Pudenti:

passages.label: Mart. 4.13.2
passages.text: Macte esto taedis, o Hymenaee, tuis.

passages.label: Mart. 4.13.3
passages.text: Tam bene rara suo miscentur cinnama nardo,

passages.label: Mart. 4.13.4
passages.text: Massica Theseis tam bene vina favis;

passages.label: Mart. 4.13.5
passages.text: Nec melius teneris iunguntur vitibus ulmi,

passages.label: Mart. 4.13.6
passages.text: Nec plus lotos aquas, litora myrtus amat.

passages.label: Mart. 4.13.7
passages.text: Candida perpetuo reside, Concordia, lecto,

passages.label: Mart. 4.13.8
passages.text: Tamque pari semper sit Venus aequa iugo:

passages.label: Mart. 4.13.9
passages.text: Diligat illa senem quondam, sed et ipsa marito

passages.label: Mart. 4.13.10
passages.text: Tum quoque, cum fuerit, non videatur anus.

passages.label: Mart. 4.14.1
passages.text: Sili, Castalidum decus sororum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.14.2
passages.text: Qui periuria barbari furoris

passages.label: Mart. 4.14.3
passages.text: Ingenti premis ore perfidosque

passages.label: Mart. 4.14.4
passages.text: Astus Hannibalis levisque Poenos

passages.label: Mart. 4.14.5
passages.text: Magnis cedere cogis Africanis:

passages.label: Mart. 4.14.6
passages.text: Paulum seposita severitate,

passages.label: Mart. 4.14.7
passages.text: Dum blanda vagus alea December

passages.label: Mart. 4.14.8
passages.text: Incertis sonat hinc et hinc fritillis

passages.label: Mart. 4.14.9
passages.text: Et ludit tropa nequiore talo,

passages.label: Mart. 4.14.10
passages.text: Nostris otia commoda Camenis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.14.11
passages.text: Nec torva lege fronte, sed remissa

passages.label: Mart. 4.14.12
passages.text: Lascivis madidos iocis libellos.

passages.label: Mart. 4.14.13
passages.text: Sic forsan tener ausus est Catullus

passages.label: Mart. 4.14.14
passages.text: Magno mittere Passerem Maroni.

passages.label: Mart. 4.15.1
passages.text: Mille tibi nummos hesterna luce roganti

passages.label: Mart. 4.15.2
passages.text: In sex aut septem, Caeciliane, dies

passages.label: Mart. 4.15.3
passages.text: 'Non habeo' dixi: sed tu causatus amici

passages.label: Mart. 4.15.4
passages.text: Adventum lancem paucaque vasa rogas.

passages.label: Mart. 4.15.5
passages.text: Stultus es? an stultum me credis, amice? negavi

passages.label: Mart. 4.15.6
passages.text: Mille tibi nummos, milia quinque dabo?

passages.label: Mart. 4.16.1
passages.text: Privignum non esse tuae te, Galle, novercae

passages.label: Mart. 4.16.2
passages.text: Rumor erat, coniunx dum fuit illa patris.

passages.label: Mart. 4.16.3
passages.text: Non tamen hoc poterat vivo genitore probari.

passages.label: Mart. 4.16.4
passages.text: Iam nusquam pater est, Galle, noverca domi est.

passages.label: Mart. 4.16.5
passages.text: Magnus ab infernis revocetur Tullius umbris

passages.label: Mart. 4.16.6
passages.text: Et te defendat Regulus ipse licet,

passages.label: Mart. 4.16.7
passages.text: Non potes absolvi: nam quae non desinit esse

passages.label: Mart. 4.16.8
passages.text: Post patrem, numquam, Galle, noverca fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 4.17.1
passages.text: Facere in Lyciscam, Paule, me iubes versus,

passages.label: Mart. 4.17.2
passages.text: Quibus illa lectis rubeat et sit irata.

passages.label: Mart. 4.17.3
passages.text: O Paule, malus es: irrumare vis solus.

passages.label: Mart. 4.18.1
passages.text: Qua vicina pluit Vipsanis porta columnis

passages.label: Mart. 4.18.2
passages.text: Et madet adsiduo lubricus imbre lapis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.18.3
passages.text: In iugulum pueri, qui roscida tecta subibat,

passages.label: Mart. 4.18.4
passages.text: Decidit hiberno praegravis unda gelu:

passages.label: Mart. 4.18.5
passages.text: Cumque peregisset miseri crudelia fata,

passages.label: Mart. 4.18.6
passages.text: Tabuit in calido volnere mucro tener.

passages.label: Mart. 4.18.7
passages.text: Quid non saeva sibi voluit Fortuna licere?

passages.label: Mart. 4.18.8
passages.text: Aut ubi non mors est, si iugulatis aquae?

passages.label: Mart. 4.19.1
passages.text: Hanc tibi Sequanicae pinguem textricis alumnam,

passages.label: Mart. 4.19.2
passages.text: Quae Lacedaemonium barbara nomen habet,

passages.label: Mart. 4.19.3
passages.text: Sordida, sed gelido non aspernanda Decembri

passages.label: Mart. 4.19.4
passages.text: Dona, peregrinam mittimus endromida:—

passages.label: Mart. 4.19.5
passages.text: Seu lentum ceroma teris tepidumve trigona,

passages.label: Mart. 4.19.6
passages.text: Sive harpasta manu pulverulenta rapis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.19.7
passages.text: Plumea seu laxi partiris pondera follis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.19.8
passages.text: Sive levem cursu vincere quaeris Athan—

passages.label: Mart. 4.19.9
passages.text: Ne madidos intret penetrabile frigus in artus,

passages.label: Mart. 4.19.10
passages.text: Neve gravis subita te premat Iris aqua.

passages.label: Mart. 4.19.11
passages.text: Ridebis ventos hoc munere tectus et imbris:

passages.label: Mart. 4.19.12
passages.text: Nec sic in Tyria sindone tutus eris.

passages.label: Mart. 4.20.1
passages.text: Dicit se vetulam, cum sit Caerellia pupa:

passages.label: Mart. 4.20.2
passages.text: Pupam se dicit Gellia, cum sit anus.

passages.label: Mart. 4.20.3
passages.text: Ferre nec hanc possis, possis, Colline, nec illam:

passages.label: Mart. 4.20.4
passages.text: Altera ridicula est, altera putidula.

passages.label: Mart. 4.21.1
passages.text: Nullos esse deos, inane caelum

passages.label: Mart. 4.21.2
passages.text: Adfirmat Segius: probatque, quod se

passages.label: Mart. 4.21.3
passages.text: Factum, dum negat haec, videt beatum.

passages.label: Mart. 4.22.1
passages.text: Primos passa toros et adhuc placanda marito

passages.label: Mart. 4.22.2
passages.text: Merserat in nitidos se Cleopatra lacus,

passages.label: Mart. 4.22.3
passages.text: Dum fugit amplexus. Sed prodidit unda latentem;

passages.label: Mart. 4.22.4
passages.text: Lucebat, totis cum tegeretur aquis:

passages.label: Mart. 4.22.5
passages.text: Condita sic puro numerantur lilia vitro,

passages.label: Mart. 4.22.6
passages.text: Sic prohibet tenuis gemma latere rosas.

passages.label: Mart. 4.22.7
passages.text: Insilui mersusque vadis luctantia carpsi

passages.label: Mart. 4.22.8
passages.text: Basia: perspicuae plus vetuistis aquae.

passages.label: Mart. 4.23.1
passages.text: Dum tu lenta nimis diuque quaeris,

passages.label: Mart. 4.23.2
passages.text: Quis primus tibi quisve sit secundus

passages.label: Mart. 4.23.3
passages.text: Graium quos epigramma conparavit:

passages.label: Mart. 4.23.4
passages.text: Palmam Callimachus, Thalia, de se

passages.label: Mart. 4.23.5
passages.text: Facundo dedit ipse Bruttiano.

passages.label: Mart. 4.23.6
passages.text: Qui si Cecropio satur lepore

passages.label: Mart. 4.23.7
passages.text: Romanae sale luserit Minervae,

passages.label: Mart. 4.23.8
passages.text: Illi me facias, precor, secundum.

passages.label: Mart. 4.24.1
passages.text: Omnes quas habuit, Fabiane, Lycoris amicas

passages.label: Mart. 4.24.2
passages.text: Extulit: uxori fiat amica meae.

passages.label: Mart. 4.25.1
passages.text: Aemula Baianis Altini litora villis

passages.label: Mart. 4.25.2
passages.text: Et Phaethontei conscia silva rogi,

passages.label: Mart. 4.25.3
passages.text: Quaeque Antenoreo Dryadum pulcherrima Fauno

passages.label: Mart. 4.25.4
passages.text: Nupsit ad Euganeos Sola puella lacus,

passages.label: Mart. 4.25.5
passages.text: Et tu Ledaeo felix Aquileia Timavo,

passages.label: Mart. 4.25.6
passages.text: Hic ubi septenas Cyllarus hausit aquas:

passages.label: Mart. 4.25.7
passages.text: Vos eritis nostrae requies portusque senectae,

passages.label: Mart. 4.25.8
passages.text: Si iuris fuerint otia nostra sui.

passages.label: Mart. 4.26.1
passages.text: Quod te mane domi toto non vidimus anno,

passages.label: Mart. 4.26.2
passages.text: Vis dicam, quantum, Postume, perdiderim?

passages.label: Mart. 4.26.3
passages.text: Tricenos, puto, bis, vicenos ter, puto, nummos.

passages.label: Mart. 4.26.4
passages.text: Ignosces: togulam, Postume, pluris emo.

passages.label: Mart. 4.27.1
passages.text: Saepe meos laudare soles, Auguste, libellos.

passages.label: Mart. 4.27.2
passages.text: Invidus ecce negat: num minus ergo soles?

passages.label: Mart. 4.27.3
passages.text: Quid, quod honorato non sola voce dedisti,

passages.label: Mart. 4.27.4
passages.text: Non alius poterat quae dare dona mihi?

passages.label: Mart. 4.27.5
passages.text: Ecce iterum nigros conrodit lividus ungues.

passages.label: Mart. 4.27.6
passages.text: Da, Caesar, tanto tu magis, ut doleat.

passages.label: Mart. 4.28.1
passages.text: Donasti tenero, Chloe, Luperco

passages.label: Mart. 4.28.2
passages.text: Hispanas Tyriasque coccinasque,

passages.label: Mart. 4.28.3
passages.text: Et lotam tepido togam Galaeso,

passages.label: Mart. 4.28.4
passages.text: Indos sardonychas, Scythas zmaragdos,

passages.label: Mart. 4.28.5
passages.text: Et centum dominos novae monetae:

passages.label: Mart. 4.28.6
passages.text: Et quidquid petit usque et usque donas.

passages.label: Mart. 4.28.7
passages.text: Vae glabraria, vae tibi misella:

passages.label: Mart. 4.28.8
passages.text: Nudam te statuet tuus Lupercus.

passages.label: Mart. 4.29.1
passages.text: Obstat, care Pudens, nostris sua turba libellis

passages.label: Mart. 4.29.2
passages.text: Lectoremque frequens lassat et implet opus.

passages.label: Mart. 4.29.3
passages.text: Rara iuvant: primis sic maior gratia pomis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.29.4
passages.text: Hibernae pretium sic meruere rosae;

passages.label: Mart. 4.29.5
passages.text: Sic spoliatricem commendat fastus amicam,

passages.label: Mart. 4.29.6
passages.text: Ianua nec iuvenem semper aperta tenet.

passages.label: Mart. 4.29.7
passages.text: Saepius in libro numeratur Persius uno,

passages.label: Mart. 4.29.8
passages.text: Quam levis in tota Marsus Amazonide.

passages.label: Mart. 4.29.9
passages.text: Tu quoque de nostris releges quemcumque libellis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.29.10
passages.text: Esse puta solum: sic tibi pluris erit.

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.1
passages.text: Baiano procul a lacu, monemus,

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.2
passages.text: Piscator, fuge, ne nocens recedas.

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.3
passages.text: Sacris piscibus hae natantur undae,

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.4
passages.text: Qui norunt dominum manumque lambunt

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.5
passages.text: Illam, qua nihil est in orbe maius.

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.6
passages.text: Quid, quod nomen habent et ad magistri

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.7
passages.text: Vocem quisque sui venit citatus?

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.8
passages.text: Hoc quondam Libys impius profundo,

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.9
passages.text: Dum praedam calamo tremente ducit,

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.10
passages.text: Raptis luminibus repente caecus

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.11
passages.text: Captum non potuit videre piscem,

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.12
passages.text: Et nunc sacrilegos perosus hamos

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.13
passages.text: Baianos sedet ad lacus rogator.

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.14
passages.text: At tu, dum potes, innocens recede

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.15
passages.text: Iactis simplicibus cibis in undas,

passages.label: Mart. 4.30.16
passages.text: Et pisces venerare delicatos.

passages.label: Mart. 4.31.1
passages.text: Quod cupis in nostris dicique legique libellis

passages.label: Mart. 4.31.2
passages.text: Et nonnullus honos creditur iste tibi,

passages.label: Mart. 4.31.3
passages.text: Ne valeam, si non res est gratissima nobis

passages.label: Mart. 4.31.4
passages.text: Et volo te chartis inseruisse meis.

passages.label: Mart. 4.31.5
passages.text: Sed tu nomen habes averso fonte sororum

passages.label: Mart. 4.31.6
passages.text: Inpositum, mater quod tibi dura dedit;

passages.label: Mart. 4.31.7
passages.text: Quod nec Melpomene, quod nec Polyhymnia possit

passages.label: Mart. 4.31.8
passages.text: Nec pia cum Phoebo dicere Calliope.

passages.label: Mart. 4.31.9
passages.text: Ergo aliquod gratum Musis tibi nomen adopta:

passages.label: Mart. 4.31.10
passages.text: Non semper belle dicitur 'Hippodame.'

passages.label: Mart. 4.32.1
passages.text: Et latet et lucet Phaethontide condita gutta,

passages.label: Mart. 4.32.2
passages.text: Ut videatur apis nectare clusa suo.

passages.label: Mart. 4.32.3
passages.text: Dignum tantorum pretium tulit illa laborum:

passages.label: Mart. 4.32.4
passages.text: Credibile est ipsam sic voluisse mori.

passages.label: Mart. 4.33.1
passages.text: Plena laboratis habeas cum scrinia libris,

passages.label: Mart. 4.33.2
passages.text: Emittis quare, Sosibiane, nihil?

passages.label: Mart. 4.33.3
passages.text: 'Edent heredes' inquis 'mea carmina.' Quando?

passages.label: Mart. 4.33.4
passages.text: Tempus erat iam te, Sosibiane, legi.

passages.label: Mart. 4.34.1
passages.text: Sordida cum tibi sit, verum tamen, Attale, dicit,

passages.label: Mart. 4.34.2
passages.text: Quisquis te niveam dicit habere togam.

passages.label: Mart. 4.35.1
passages.text: Frontibus adversis molles concurrere dammas

passages.label: Mart. 4.35.2
passages.text: Vidimus et fati sorte iacere pari.

passages.label: Mart. 4.35.3
passages.text: Spectavere canes praedam, stupuitque superbus

passages.label: Mart. 4.35.4
passages.text: Venator, cultro nil superesse suo.

passages.label: Mart. 4.35.5
passages.text: Unde leves animi tanto caluere furore?

passages.label: Mart. 4.35.6
passages.text: Sic pugnant tauri, sic cecidere viri.

passages.label: Mart. 4.36.1
passages.text: Cana est barba tibi, nigra est coma: tinguere barbam

passages.label: Mart. 4.36.2
passages.text: Non potes—haec causa est—et potes, Ole, comam.

passages.label: Mart. 4.37.1
passages.text: 'Centum Coranus et ducenta Mancinus,

passages.label: Mart. 4.37.2
passages.text: Trecenta debet Titius, hoc bis Albinus,

passages.label: Mart. 4.37.3
passages.text: Decies Sabinus alterumque Serranus;

passages.label: Mart. 4.37.4
passages.text: Ex insulis fundisque tricies soldum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.37.5
passages.text: Ex pecore redeunt ter ducena Parmensi':

passages.label: Mart. 4.37.6
passages.text: Totis diebus, Afer, hoc mihi narras

passages.label: Mart. 4.37.7
passages.text: Et teneo melius ista, quam meum nomen.

passages.label: Mart. 4.37.8
passages.text: Numeres oportet aliquid, ut pati possim:

passages.label: Mart. 4.37.9
passages.text: Cotidianam refice nauseam nummis:

passages.label: Mart. 4.37.10
passages.text: Audire gratis, Afer, ista non possum.

passages.label: Mart. 4.38.1
passages.text: Galla, nega: satiatur amor, nisi gaudia torquent:

passages.label: Mart. 4.38.2
passages.text: Sed noli nimium, Galla, negare diu.

passages.label: Mart. 4.39.1
passages.text: Argenti genus omne comparasti,

passages.label: Mart. 4.39.2
passages.text: Et solus veteres Myronos artes,

passages.label: Mart. 4.39.3
passages.text: Solus Praxitelus manum Scopaeque,

passages.label: Mart. 4.39.4
passages.text: Solus Phidiaci toreuma caeli,

passages.label: Mart. 4.39.5
passages.text: Solus Mentoreos habes labores.

passages.label: Mart. 4.39.6
passages.text: Nec desunt tibi vera Gratiana,

passages.label: Mart. 4.39.7
passages.text: Nec quae Callaico linuntur auro,

passages.label: Mart. 4.39.8
passages.text: Nec mensis anaglypta de paternis.

passages.label: Mart. 4.39.9
passages.text: Argentum tamen inter omne miror

passages.label: Mart. 4.39.10
passages.text: Quare non habeas, Charine, purum.

passages.label: Mart. 4.40.1
passages.text: Atria Pisonum stabant cum stemmate toto

passages.label: Mart. 4.40.2
passages.text: Et docti Senecae ter numeranda domus;

passages.label: Mart. 4.40.3
passages.text: Praetulimus tantis solum te, Postume, regnis:

passages.label: Mart. 4.40.4
passages.text: Pauper eras et eques, sed mihi consul eras.

passages.label: Mart. 4.40.5
passages.text: Tecum ter denas numeravi, Postume, brumas:

passages.label: Mart. 4.40.6
passages.text: Communis nobis lectus et unus erat.

passages.label: Mart. 4.40.7
passages.text: Iam donare potes, iam perdere, plenus honorum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.40.8
passages.text: Largus opum: expecto, Postume, quid facias.

passages.label: Mart. 4.40.9
passages.text: Nil facis, et serumst alium mihi quaerere regem.—

passages.label: Mart. 4.40.10
passages.text: Hoc, Fortuna, placet? 'Postumus inposuit.'

passages.label: Mart. 4.41.1
passages.text: Quid recitaturus circumdas vellera collo?

passages.label: Mart. 4.41.2
passages.text: Conveniunt nostris auribus ista magis.

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.1
passages.text: Si quis forte mihi possit praestare roganti,

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.2
passages.text: Audi, quem puerum, Flacce, rogare velim.

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.3
passages.text: Niliacis primum puer hic nascatur in oris:

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.4
passages.text: Nequitias tellus scit dare nulla magis.

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.5
passages.text: Sit nive candidior: namque in Mareotide fusca

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.6
passages.text: Pulchrior est, quanto rarior, iste color.

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.7
passages.text: Lumina sideribus certent mollesque flagellent

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.8
passages.text: Colla comae: tortas non amo, Flacce, comas.

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.9
passages.text: Frons brevis atque modus leviter sit naribus uncis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.10
passages.text: Paestanis rubeant aemula labra rosis.

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.11
passages.text: Saepe et nolentem cogat nolitque volentem,

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.12
passages.text: Liberior domino saepe sit ille suo;

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.13
passages.text: Et timeat pueros, excludat saepe puellas:

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.14
passages.text: Vir reliquis, uni sit puer ille mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.15
passages.text: 'Iam scio, nec fallis: nam me quoque iudice verum est.

passages.label: Mart. 4.42.16
passages.text: Talis erat' dices 'noster Amazonicus.'

passages.label: Mart. 4.43.1
passages.text: Non dixi, Coracine, te cinaedum:

passages.label: Mart. 4.43.2
passages.text: Non sum tam temerarius nec audax

passages.label: Mart. 4.43.3
passages.text: Nec mendacia qui loquar libenter.

passages.label: Mart. 4.43.4
passages.text: Si dixi, Coracine, te cinaedum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.43.5
passages.text: Iratam mihi Pontiae lagonam,

passages.label: Mart. 4.43.6
passages.text: Iratum calicem mihi Metili:

passages.label: Mart. 4.43.7
passages.text: Iuro per Syrios tibi tumores,

passages.label: Mart. 4.43.8
passages.text: Iuro per Berecyntios furores.

passages.label: Mart. 4.43.9
passages.text: Quid dixi tamen? Hoc leve et pusillum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.43.10
passages.text: Quod notum est, quod et ipse non negabis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.43.11
passages.text: Dixi te, Coracine, cunnilingum.

passages.label: Mart. 4.44.1
passages.text: Hic est pampineis viridis modo Vesbius umbris,

passages.label: Mart. 4.44.2
passages.text: Presserat hic madidos nobilis uva lacus:

passages.label: Mart. 4.44.3
passages.text: Haec iuga, quam Nysae colles, plus Bacchus amavit,

passages.label: Mart. 4.44.4
passages.text: Hoc nuper Satyri monte dedere choros.

passages.label: Mart. 4.44.5
passages.text: Haec Veneris sedes, Lacedaemone gratior illi,

passages.label: Mart. 4.44.6
passages.text: Hic locus Herculeo numine clarus erat.

passages.label: Mart. 4.44.7
passages.text: Cuncta iacent flammis et tristi mersa favilla:

passages.label: Mart. 4.44.8
passages.text: Nec superi vellent hoc licuisse sibi.

passages.label: Mart. 4.45.1
passages.text: Haec tibi pro nato plena dat laetus acerra,

passages.label: Mart. 4.45.2
passages.text: Phoebe, Palatinus munera Parthenius,

passages.label: Mart. 4.45.3
passages.text: Ut qui prima novo signat quinquennia lustro,

passages.label: Mart. 4.45.4
passages.text: Impleat innumeras Burrus Olympiadas.

passages.label: Mart. 4.45.5
passages.text: Fac rata vota patris: sic te tua diligat arbor

passages.label: Mart. 4.45.6
passages.text: Gaudeat et certa virginitate soror,

passages.label: Mart. 4.45.7
passages.text: Perpetuo sic flore mices, sic denique non sint

passages.label: Mart. 4.45.8
passages.text: Tam longae Bromio, quam tibi, Phoebe, comae.

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.1
passages.text: Saturnalia divitem Sabellum

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.2
passages.text: Fecerunt: merito tumet Sabellus,

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.3
passages.text: Nec quemquam putat esse praedicatque

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.4
passages.text: Inter causidicos beatiorem.

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.5
passages.text: Hos fastus animosque dat Sabello

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.6
passages.text: Farris semodius fabaeque fresae,

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.7
passages.text: Et turis piperisque tres selibrae,

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.8
passages.text: Et Lucanica ventre cum Falisco,

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.9
passages.text: Et nigri Syra defruti lagona,

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.10
passages.text: Et ficus Libyca gelata testa

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.11
passages.text: Cum bulbis cocleisque caseoque.

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.12
passages.text: Piceno quoque venit a cliente

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.13
passages.text: Parcae cistula non capax olivae,

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.14
passages.text: Et crasso figuli polita caelo

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.15
passages.text: Septenaria synthesis Sagunti,

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.16
passages.text: Hispanae luteum rotae toreuma,

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.17
passages.text: Et lato variata mappa clavo.

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.18
passages.text: Saturnalia fructuosiora

passages.label: Mart. 4.46.19
passages.text: Annis non habuit decem Sabellus.

passages.label: Mart. 4.47.1
passages.text: Encaustus Phaethon tabula tibi pictus in hac est.

passages.label: Mart. 4.47.2
passages.text: Quid tibi vis, dipyrum qui Phaethonta facis?

passages.label: Mart. 4.48.1
passages.text: Percidi gaudes, percisus, Papyle, ploras.

passages.label: Mart. 4.48.2
passages.text: Cur, quae vis fieri, Papyle, facta doles?

passages.label: Mart. 4.48.3
passages.text: Paenitet obscenae pruriginis? an magis illud

passages.label: Mart. 4.48.4
passages.text: Fles, quod percidi, Papyle, desieris?

passages.label: Mart. 4.49.1
passages.text: Nescit, crede mihi, quid sint epigrammata, Flacce,

passages.label: Mart. 4.49.2
passages.text: Qui tantum lusus ista iocosque vocat.

passages.label: Mart. 4.49.3
passages.text: Ille magis ludit, qui scribit prandia saevi

passages.label: Mart. 4.49.4
passages.text: Tereos, aut cenam, crude Thyesta, tuam,

passages.label: Mart. 4.49.5
passages.text: Aut puero liquidas aptantem Daedalon alas,

passages.label: Mart. 4.49.6
passages.text: Pascentem Siculas aut Polyphemon ovis.

passages.label: Mart. 4.49.7
passages.text: A nostris procul est omnis vesica libellis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.49.8
passages.text: Musa nec insano syrmate nostra tumet.

passages.label: Mart. 4.49.9
passages.text: 'Illa tamen laudant omnes, mirantur, adorant.'

passages.label: Mart. 4.49.10
passages.text: Confiteor: laudant illa, sed ista legunt.

passages.label: Mart. 4.50.1
passages.text: Quid me, Thai, senem subinde dicis?

passages.label: Mart. 4.50.2
passages.text: Nemo est, Thai, senex ad irrumandum.

passages.label: Mart. 4.51.1
passages.text: Cum tibi non essent sex milia, Caeciliane,

passages.label: Mart. 4.51.2
passages.text: Ingenti late vectus es hexaphoro:

passages.label: Mart. 4.51.3
passages.text: Postquam bis decies tribuit dea caeca sinumque

passages.label: Mart. 4.51.4
passages.text: Ruperunt nummi, factus es, ecce, pedes.

passages.label: Mart. 4.51.5
passages.text: Quid tibi pro meritis et tantis laudibus optem?

passages.label: Mart. 4.51.6
passages.text: Di reddant sellam, Caeciliane, tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 4.52.1
passages.text: Gestari iunctis nisi desinis, Hedyle, capris,

passages.label: Mart. 4.52.2
passages.text: Qui modo ficus eras, iam caprificus eris.

passages.label: Mart. 4.53.1
passages.text: Hunc, quem saepe vides intra penetralia nostrae

passages.label: Mart. 4.53.2
passages.text: Pallados et templi limina, Cosme, novi

passages.label: Mart. 4.53.3
passages.text: Cum baculo peraque senem, cui cana putrisque

passages.label: Mart. 4.53.4
passages.text: Stat coma et in pectus sordida barba cadit,

passages.label: Mart. 4.53.5
passages.text: Cerea quem nudi tegit uxor abolla grabati,

passages.label: Mart. 4.53.6
passages.text: Cui dat latratos obvia turba cibos,

passages.label: Mart. 4.53.7
passages.text: Esse putas Cynicum deceptus imagine ficta:

passages.label: Mart. 4.53.8
passages.text: Non est hic Cynicus, Cosme: quid ergo? Canis.

passages.label: Mart. 4.54.1
passages.text: O cui Tarpeias licuit contingere quercus

passages.label: Mart. 4.54.2
passages.text: Et meritas prima cingere fronde comas,

passages.label: Mart. 4.54.3
passages.text: Si sapis, utaris totis, Colline, diebus

passages.label: Mart. 4.54.4
passages.text: Extremumque tibi semper adesse putes.

passages.label: Mart. 4.54.5
passages.text: Lanificas nulli tres exorare puellas

passages.label: Mart. 4.54.6
passages.text: Contigit: observant quem statuere diem.

passages.label: Mart. 4.54.7
passages.text: Divitior Crispo, Thrasea constantior ipso

passages.label: Mart. 4.54.8
passages.text: Lautior et nitido sis Meliore licet:

passages.label: Mart. 4.54.9
passages.text: Nil adicit penso Lachesis fusosque sororum

passages.label: Mart. 4.54.10
passages.text: Explicat et semper de tribus una negat.

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.1
passages.text: Luci, gloria temporum tuorum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.2
passages.text: Qui Caium veterem Tagumque nostrum

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.3
passages.text: Arpis cedere non sinis disertis:

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.4
passages.text: Argivas generatus inter urbes

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.5
passages.text: Thebas carmine cantet aut Mycenas,

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.6
passages.text: Aut claram Rhodon aut libidinosae

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.7
passages.text: Ledaeas Lacedaemonos palaestras:

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.8
passages.text: Nos Celtis genitos et ex Hiberis

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.9
passages.text: Nostrae nomina duriora terrae

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.10
passages.text: Grato non pudeat referre versu:

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.11
passages.text: Saevo Bilbilin optimam metallo,

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.12
passages.text: Quae vincit Chalybasque Noricosque,

passages.text: Et ferro Plateam suo sonantem,

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.14
passages.text: Quam fluctu tenui, sed inquieto

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.15
passages.text: Armorum Salo temperator ambit,

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.16
passages.text: Tutelamque chorosque Rixamarum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.17
passages.text: Et convivia festa Carduarum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.18
passages.text: Et textis Peterin rosis rubentem,

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.19
passages.text: Atque antiqua patrum theatra Rigas,

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.20
passages.text: Et certos iaculo levi Silaos,

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.21
passages.text: Turgontique lacus Turasiaeque,

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.22
passages.text: Et parvae vada pura Tvetonissae,

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.23
passages.text: Et sanctum Buradonis ilicetum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.24
passages.text: Per quod vel piger ambulat viator,

passages.text: Et quae fortibus excolit iuvencis

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.26
passages.text: Curvae Manlius arva Vativescae.

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.27
passages.text: Haec tam rustica, delicate lector,

passages.text: Rides nomina? rideas licebit,

passages.label: Mart. 4.55.29
passages.text: Haec tam rustica malo, quam Butuntos.

passages.label: Mart. 4.56.1
passages.text: Munera quod senibus viduisque ingentia mittis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.56.2
passages.text: Vis te munificum, Gargiliane, vocem?

passages.label: Mart. 4.56.3
passages.text: Sordidius nihil est, nihil est te spurcius uno,

passages.label: Mart. 4.56.4
passages.text: Qui potes insidias dona vocare tuas:

passages.label: Mart. 4.56.5
passages.text: Sic avidis fallax indulget piscibus hamus,

passages.label: Mart. 4.56.6
passages.text: Callida sic stultas decipit esca feras.

passages.label: Mart. 4.56.7
passages.text: Quid sit largiri, quid sit donare, docebo,

passages.label: Mart. 4.56.8
passages.text: Si nescis: dona, Gargiliane, mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 4.57.1
passages.text: Dum nos blanda tenent lascivi stagna Lucrini

passages.label: Mart. 4.57.2
passages.text: Et quae pumiceis fontibus antra calent,

passages.text: Tu colis Argei regnum, Faustine, coloni,

passages.text: Quo te bis decimus ducit ab urbe lapis.

passages.text: Horrida sed fervent Nemeaei pectora monstri,

passages.text: Ergo sacri fontes et litora grata valete,

passages.label: Mart. 4.57.9
passages.text: Herculeos colles gelida vos vincite bruma,

passages.label: Mart. 4.57.10
passages.text: Nunc Tiburtinis cedite frigoribus.

passages.label: Mart. 4.58.1
passages.text: In tenebris luges amissum, Galla, maritum.

passages.label: Mart. 4.58.2
passages.text: Iam plorare pudet te, puto, Galla, virum.

passages.text: Flentibus Heliadum ramis dum vipera repit,

passages.label: Mart. 4.59.2
passages.text: Fluxit in obstantem sucina gutta feram:

passages.text: Quae dum miratur pingui se rore teneri,

passages.label: Mart. 4.59.4
passages.text: Concreto riguit vincta repente gelu.

passages.label: Mart. 4.59.5
passages.text: Ne tibi regali placeas, Cleopatra, sepulchro,

passages.text: Vipera si tumulo nobiliore iacet.

passages.label: Mart. 4.60.1
passages.text: Ardea solstitio Castranaque rura petantur

passages.label: Mart. 4.60.2
passages.text: Quique Cleonaeo sidere fervet ager,

passages.text: Cum Tiburtinas damnet Curiatius auras

passages.label: Mart. 4.60.4
passages.text: Inter laudatas ad Styga missus aquas.

passages.label: Mart. 4.60.5
passages.text: Nullo fata loco possis excludere: cum mors

passages.label: Mart. 4.60.6
passages.text: Venerit, in medio Tibure Sardinia est.

passages.text: Donasse amicum tibi ducenta, Mancine,

passages.label: Mart. 4.61.2
passages.text: Nuper superbo laetus ore iactasti.

passages.label: Mart. 4.61.3
passages.text: Quartus dies est, in schola poetarum

passages.text: Dum fabulamur, milibus decem dixti

passages.label: Mart. 4.61.5
passages.text: Emptas lacernas munus esse Pompullae,

passages.text: Sardonycha verum lineisque ter cinctum

passages.label: Mart. 4.61.7
passages.text: Duasque similes fluctibus maris gemmas

passages.label: Mart. 4.61.8
passages.text: Dedisse Bassam Caeliamque iurasti.

passages.label: Mart. 4.61.9
passages.text: Here de theatro, Pollione cantante,

passages.label: Mart. 4.61.10
passages.text: Cum subito abires, dum fugis, loquebaris,

passages.label: Mart. 4.61.11
passages.text: Hereditatis tibi trecenta venisse,

passages.label: Mart. 4.61.12
passages.text: Et mane centum, et post meridie centum.

passages.label: Mart. 4.61.13
passages.text: Quid tibi sodales fecimus mali tantum?

passages.label: Mart. 4.61.14
passages.text: Miserere iam, crudelis, et sile tandem.

passages.label: Mart. 4.61.15
passages.text: Aut, si tacere lingua non potest ista,

passages.label: Mart. 4.61.16
passages.text: Aliquando narra, quod velimus audire.

passages.label: Mart. 4.62.1
passages.text: Tibur in Herculeum migravit nigra Lycoris,

passages.label: Mart. 4.62.2
passages.text: Omnia dum fieri candida credit ibi.

passages.label: Mart. 4.63.1
passages.text: Dum petit a Baulis mater Caerellia Baias,

passages.label: Mart. 4.63.2
passages.text: Occidit insani crimine mersa freti.

passages.label: Mart. 4.63.3
passages.text: Gloria quanta perit vobis! haec monstra Neroni

passages.label: Mart. 4.63.4
passages.text: Nec iussae quondam praestiteratis, aquae.

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.1
passages.text: Iuli iugera pauca Martialis

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.2
passages.text: Hortis Hesperidum beatiora

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.3
passages.text: Longo Ianiculi iugo recumbunt:

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.4
passages.text: Lati collibus eminent recessus,

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.5
passages.text: Et planus modico tumore vertex

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.6
passages.text: Caelo perfruitur sereniore

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.7
passages.text: Et curvas nebula tegente valles

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.8
passages.text: Solus luce nitet peculiari;

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.9
passages.text: Puris leniter admoventur astris

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.10
passages.text: Celsae culmina delicata villae.

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.11
passages.text: Hinc septem dominos videre montis

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.12
passages.text: Et totam licet aestimare Romam,

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.13
passages.text: Albanos quoque Tusculosque colles

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.14
passages.text: Et quodcumque iacet sub urbe frigus,

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.15
passages.text: Fidenas veteres brevesque Rubras,

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.16
passages.text: Et quod virgineo cruore gaudet

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.17
passages.text: Annae pomiferum nemus Perennae.

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.18
passages.text: Illinc Flaminiae Salariaeque

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.19
passages.text: Gestator patet essedo tacente,

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.20
passages.text: Ne blando rota sit molesta somno,

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.21
passages.text: Quem nec rumpere nauticum celeuma

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.22
passages.text: Nec clamor valet helciariorum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.23
passages.text: Cum sit tam prope Mulvius sacrumque

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.24
passages.text: Lapsae per Tiberim volent carinae.

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.25
passages.text: Hoc rus, seu potius domus vocanda est,

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.26
passages.text: Commendat dominus: tuam putabis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.27
passages.text: Tam non invida tamque liberalis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.28
passages.text: Tam comi patet hospitalitate:

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.29
passages.text: Credas Alcinoi pios Penates

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.30
passages.text: Aut facti modo divitis Molorchi.

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.31
passages.text: Vos nunc omnia parva qui putatis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.32
passages.text: Centeno gelidum ligone Tibur

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.33
passages.text: Vel Praeneste domate pendulamque

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.34
passages.text: Uni dedite Setiam colono,

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.35
passages.text: Dum me iudice praeferantur istis

passages.label: Mart. 4.64.36
passages.text: Iuli iugera pauca Martialis.

passages.label: Mart. 4.65.1
passages.text: Oculo Philaenis semper altero plorat.

passages.label: Mart. 4.65.2
passages.text: Quo fiat istud quaeritis modo? lusca est.

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.1
passages.text: Egisti vitam semper, Line, municipalem,

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.2
passages.text: Qua nihil omnino vilius esse potest.

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.3
passages.text: Idibus et raris togula est excussa Kalendis

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.4
passages.text: Duxit et aestates synthesis una decem.

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.5
passages.text: Saltus aprum, campus leporem tibi misit inemptum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.6
passages.text: Silva gravis turdos exagitata dedit,

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.7
passages.text: Captus flumineo venit de gurgite piscis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.8
passages.text: Vina ruber fudit non peregrina cadus.

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.9
passages.text: Nec tener Argolica missus de gente minister,

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.10
passages.text: Sed stetit inculti rustica turba foci.

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.11
passages.text: Vilica vel duri conpressa est nupta coloni,

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.12
passages.text: Incaluit quotiens saucia vena mero.

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.13
passages.text: Nec nocuit tectis ignis, nec Sirius agris,

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.14
passages.text: Nec mersa est pelago nec fuit ulla ratis.

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.15
passages.text: Subposita est blando numquam tibi tessera talo,

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.16
passages.text: Alea sed parcae sola fuere nuces.

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.17
passages.text: Dic, ubi sit decies, mater quod avara reliquit.

passages.label: Mart. 4.66.18
passages.text: Nusquam est: fecisti rem, Line, difficilem.

passages.label: Mart. 4.67.1
passages.text: Praetorem pauper centum sestertia Gaurus

passages.label: Mart. 4.67.2
passages.text: Orabat cana notus amicitia,

passages.label: Mart. 4.67.3
passages.text: Dicebatque suis haec tantum deesse trecentis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.67.4
passages.text: Ut posset domino plaudere iustus eques.

passages.label: Mart. 4.67.5
passages.text: Praetor ait 'Scis me Scorpo Thalloque daturum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.67.6
passages.text: Atque utinam centum milia sola darem.'

passages.label: Mart. 4.67.7
passages.text: A pudet ingratae, pudet a male divitis arcae.

passages.label: Mart. 4.67.8
passages.text: Quod non das equiti, vis dare, praetor, equo?

passages.label: Mart. 4.68.1
passages.text: Invitas centum quadrantibus et bene cenas.

passages.label: Mart. 4.68.2
passages.text: Ut cenem invitor, Sexte, an ut invideam?

passages.label: Mart. 4.69.1
passages.text: Tu Setina quidem semper vel Massica ponis,

passages.label: Mart. 4.69.2
passages.text: Papyle, sed rumor tam bona vina negat:

passages.label: Mart. 4.69.3
passages.text: Diceris hac factus caelebs quater esse lagona.

passages.label: Mart. 4.69.4
passages.text: Nec puto nec credo, Papyle, nec sitio.

passages.label: Mart. 4.70.1
passages.text: Nihil Ammiano praeter aridam restem

passages.label: Mart. 4.70.2
passages.text: Moriens reliquit ultimis pater ceris.

passages.label: Mart. 4.70.3
passages.text: Fieri putaret posse quis, Marulline,

passages.label: Mart. 4.70.4
passages.text: Ut Ammianus mortuum patrem nollet?

passages.label: Mart. 4.71.1
passages.text: Quaero diu totam, Safroni Rufe, per urbem,

passages.label: Mart. 4.71.2
passages.text: Si qua puella neget: nulla puella negat.

passages.label: Mart. 4.71.3
passages.text: Tamquam fas non sit, tamquam sit turpe negare,

passages.label: Mart. 4.71.4
passages.text: Tamquam non liceat: nulla puella negat.

passages.label: Mart. 4.71.5
passages.text: Casta igitur nulla est? sunt castae mille: quid ergo

passages.label: Mart. 4.71.6
passages.text: Casta facit? non dat, non tamen illa negat.

passages.label: Mart. 4.72.1
passages.text: Exigis, ut donem nostros tibi, Quinte, libellos.

passages.label: Mart. 4.72.2
passages.text: Non habeo, sed habet bibliopola Tryphon.

passages.label: Mart. 4.72.3
passages.text: 'Aes dabo pro nugis et emam tua carmina sanus?

passages.label: Mart. 4.72.4
passages.text: Non' inquis 'faciam tam fatue.' Nec ego.

passages.label: Mart. 4.73.1
passages.text: Cum gravis extremas Vestinus duceret horas

passages.label: Mart. 4.73.2
passages.text: Et iam per Stygias esset iturus aquas,

passages.label: Mart. 4.73.3
passages.text: Ultima volventis oravit pensa sorores,

passages.label: Mart. 4.73.4
passages.text: Ut traherent parva stamina pulla mora,

passages.label: Mart. 4.73.5
passages.text: Iam sibi defunctus caris dum vivit amicis.

passages.label: Mart. 4.73.6
passages.text: Moverunt tetricas tam pia vota deas.

passages.label: Mart. 4.73.7
passages.text: Tunc largas partitus opes a luce recessit

passages.label: Mart. 4.73.8
passages.text: Seque mori post hoc credidit ille senem.

passages.label: Mart. 4.74.1
passages.text: Aspicis, inbelles temptent quam fortia dammae

passages.label: Mart. 4.74.2
passages.text: Proelia? tam timidis quanta sit ira feris?

passages.label: Mart. 4.74.3
passages.text: In mortem parvis concurrere frontibus ardent.

passages.label: Mart. 4.74.4
passages.text: Vis, Caesar, dammis parcere? mitte canes.

passages.label: Mart. 4.75.1
passages.text: O felix animo, felix, Nigrina, marito

passages.label: Mart. 4.75.2
passages.text: Atque inter Latias gloria prima nurus:

passages.label: Mart. 4.75.3
passages.text: Te patrios miscere iuvat cum coniuge census,

passages.label: Mart. 4.75.4
passages.text: Gaudentem socio participique viro.

passages.label: Mart. 4.75.5
passages.text: Arserit Euhadne flammis iniecta mariti,

passages.label: Mart. 4.75.6
passages.text: Nec minor Alcestin fama sub astra ferat:

passages.label: Mart. 4.75.7
passages.text: Tu melius: certo meruisti pignore vitae,

passages.label: Mart. 4.75.8
passages.text: Ut tibi non esset morte probandus amor.

passages.label: Mart. 4.76.1
passages.text: Milia misisti mihi sex bis sena petenti:

passages.label: Mart. 4.76.2
passages.text: Ut bis sena feram, bis duodena petam.

passages.label: Mart. 4.77.1
passages.text: Numquam divitias deos rogavi

passages.label: Mart. 4.77.2
passages.text: Contentus modicis meoque laetus:

passages.label: Mart. 4.77.3
passages.text: Paupertas, veniam dabis, recede.

passages.label: Mart. 4.77.4
passages.text: Causast quae subiti novique voti?

passages.label: Mart. 4.77.5
passages.text: Pendentem volo Zoilum videre.

passages.label: Mart. 4.78.1
passages.text: Condita cum tibi sit iam sexagensima messis

passages.label: Mart. 4.78.2
passages.text: Et facies multo splendeat alba pilo,

passages.label: Mart. 4.78.3
passages.text: Discurris tota vagus urbe, nec ulla cathedra est,

passages.label: Mart. 4.78.4
passages.text: Cui non mane feras inrequietus Have;

passages.label: Mart. 4.78.5
passages.text: Et sine te nulli fas est prodire tribuno,

passages.label: Mart. 4.78.6
passages.text: Nec caret officio consul uterque tuo;

passages.label: Mart. 4.78.7
passages.text: Et sacro decies repetis Palatia clivo

passages.label: Mart. 4.78.8
passages.text: Sigerosque meros Partheniosque sonas.

passages.label: Mart. 4.78.9
passages.text: Haec faciant sane iuvenes: deformius, Afer,

passages.label: Mart. 4.78.10
passages.text: Omnino nihil est ardalione sene.

passages.label: Mart. 4.79.1
passages.text: Hospes eras nostri semper, Matho, Tiburtini.

passages.label: Mart. 4.79.2
passages.text: Hoc emis. Inposui: rus tibi vendo tuum.

passages.label: Mart. 4.80.1
passages.text: Declamas in febre, Maron: hanc esse phrenesin

passages.label: Mart. 4.80.2
passages.text: Si nescis, non es sanus, amice Maron.

passages.label: Mart. 4.80.3
passages.text: Declamas aeger, declamas hemitritaeos:

passages.label: Mart. 4.80.4
passages.text: Si sudare aliter non potes, est ratio.

passages.label: Mart. 4.80.5
passages.text: 'Magna tamen res est.' Erras; cum viscera febris

passages.label: Mart. 4.80.6
passages.text: Exurit, res est magna tacere, Maron.

passages.label: Mart. 4.81.1
passages.text: Epigramma nostrum cum Fabulla legisset,

passages.label: Mart. 4.81.2
passages.text: Negare nullam quo queror puellarum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.81.3
passages.text: Semel rogata bisque terque neglexit

passages.label: Mart. 4.81.4
passages.text: Preces amantis. Iam, Fabulla, promitte:

passages.label: Mart. 4.81.5
passages.text: Negare iussi, pernegare non iussi.

passages.label: Mart. 4.82.1
passages.text: Hos quoque commenda Venuleio, Rufe, libellos,

passages.label: Mart. 4.82.2
passages.text: Inputet et nobis otia parva roga,

passages.label: Mart. 4.82.3
passages.text: Immemor et paulum curarum operumque suorum

passages.label: Mart. 4.82.4
passages.text: Non tetrica nugas exigat aure meas.

passages.label: Mart. 4.82.5
passages.text: Sed nec post primum legat haec summumve trientem,

passages.label: Mart. 4.82.6
passages.text: Sed sua cum medius proelia Bacchus amat.

passages.label: Mart. 4.82.7
passages.text: Si nimis est legisse duos, tibi charta plicetur

passages.label: Mart. 4.82.8
passages.text: Altera: divisum sic breve fiet opus.

passages.label: Mart. 4.83.1
passages.text: Securo nihil est te, Naevole, peius: eodem

passages.label: Mart. 4.83.2
passages.text: Sollicito nihil est, Naevole, te melius.

passages.label: Mart. 4.83.3
passages.text: Securus nullum resalutas, despicis omnes,

passages.label: Mart. 4.83.4
passages.text: Nec quisquam liber nec tibi natus homo est:

passages.label: Mart. 4.83.5
passages.text: Sollicitus donas, dominum regemque salutas,

passages.label: Mart. 4.83.6
passages.text: Invitas. Esto, Naevole, sollicitus.

passages.label: Mart. 4.84.1
passages.text: Non est in populo nec urbe tota,

passages.label: Mart. 4.84.2
passages.text: A se Thaida qui probet fututam,

passages.label: Mart. 4.84.3
passages.text: Cum multi cupiant rogentque multi.

passages.label: Mart. 4.84.4
passages.text: Tam casta est, rogo, Thais? Immo fellat.

passages.label: Mart. 4.85.1
passages.text: Nos bibimus vitro, tu murra, Pontice. Quare?

passages.label: Mart. 4.85.2
passages.text: Prodat perspicuus ne duo vina calix.

passages.label: Mart. 4.86.1
passages.text: Si vis auribus Atticis probari,

passages.label: Mart. 4.86.2
passages.text: Exhortor moneoque te, libelle,

passages.label: Mart. 4.86.3
passages.text: Ut docto placeas Apollinari.

passages.label: Mart. 4.86.4
passages.text: Nil exactius eruditiusque est,

passages.label: Mart. 4.86.5
passages.text: Sed nec candidius benigniusque:

passages.label: Mart. 4.86.6
passages.text: Si te pectore, si tenebit ore,

passages.label: Mart. 4.86.7
passages.text: Nec rhonchos metues maligniorum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.86.8
passages.text: Nec scombris tunicas dabis molestas.

passages.label: Mart. 4.86.9
passages.text: Si damnaverit, ad salariorum

passages.label: Mart. 4.86.10
passages.text: Curras scrinia protinus licebit,

passages.label: Mart. 4.86.11
passages.text: Inversa pueris arande charta.

passages.label: Mart. 4.87.1
passages.text: Infantem secum semper tua Bassa, Fabulle,

passages.label: Mart. 4.87.2
passages.text: Conlocat et lusus deliciasque vocat,

passages.label: Mart. 4.87.3
passages.text: Et, quo mireris magis, infantaria non est.

passages.label: Mart. 4.87.4
passages.text: Ergo quid in causa est? Pedere Bassa solet.

passages.label: Mart. 4.88.1
passages.text: Nulla remisisti parvo pro munere dona,

passages.label: Mart. 4.88.2
passages.text: Et iam Saturni quinque fuere dies.

passages.label: Mart. 4.88.3
passages.text: Ergo nec argenti sex scripula Septiciani

passages.label: Mart. 4.88.4
passages.text: Missa nec a querulo mappa cliente fuit,

passages.label: Mart. 4.88.5
passages.text: Antipolitani nec quae de sanguine thynni

passages.label: Mart. 4.88.6
passages.text: Testa rubet, nec quae cottana parva gerit,

passages.label: Mart. 4.88.7
passages.text: Nec rugosarum vimen breve Picenarum,

passages.label: Mart. 4.88.8
passages.text: Dicere te posses ut meminisse mei?

passages.label: Mart. 4.88.9
passages.text: Decipies alios verbis voltuque benigno,

passages.label: Mart. 4.88.10
passages.text: Nam mihi iam notus dissimulator eris.

passages.label: Mart. 4.89.1
passages.text: Ohe, iam satis est, ohe, libelle,

passages.label: Mart. 4.89.2
passages.text: Iam pervenimus usque ad umbilicos.

passages.label: Mart. 4.89.3
passages.text: Tu procedere adhuc et ire quaeris,

passages.label: Mart. 4.89.4
passages.text: Nec summa potes in schida teneri,

passages.label: Mart. 4.89.5
passages.text: Sic tamquam tibi res peracta non sit,

passages.label: Mart. 4.89.6
passages.text: Quae prima quoque pagina peracta est.

passages.label: Mart. 4.89.7
passages.text: Iam lector queriturque deficitque,

passages.label: Mart. 4.89.8
passages.text: Iam librarius hoc et ipse dicit

passages.label: Mart. 4.89.9
passages.text: 'Ohe, iam satis est, ohe, libelle.'
